name: privacy-settings-section
title: Privacy settings section
description: Who can see your profile and what you share: visibility as choice cards, then switches for activity, search and analytics, each saying what it changes for others.
docs: Controlled: keep value in state and set it in onChange. Changes apply at once; return a promise from onChange and the status line shows Saving, then the confirmation or an error. Applying the settings (who may read the profile, robots tags, analytics) is yours.
